verdict.rationale: Composio ships an official hosted MCP server (Composio Connect at https://connect.composio.dev/mcp) plus per-session MCP endpoints (`mcp: true`) that expose meta-tools and toolkit-specific tool sets, documented in first-party docs and confirmed live via probe. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that agents actually connect and operate successfully through the MCP endpoint (only unrelated connector-specific community complaints exist, not about MCP itself).
